summary: Saint Nicholas was a bishop known for generosity and care for the poor. His life speaks of practical charity and steadfast faith.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Nicholas as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Nicholas, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
